why_ai: Licensed optometrists examine eyes in person, sign every diagnosis and prescription, and manage disease over years, though refraction is starting to automate and vision plans steer patients between providers.
why_clarity: A prescription is measurable and annual exams recur almost identically, but disease judgement and its outcomes unfold over years.
why_digital: Care starts from a patient in the chair, devices and records are digital, and glasses and exams are delivered in person by local practices.

why_ai: Choosing the payer split from the note and plan rules is screen work that rules engines and models can do, with the practice keeping audit liability.
why_clarity: Plan rules and medical-necessity logic are written down, every exam repeats the decision, and remittances confirm it within weeks.
why_digital: The work starts from notes, codes and plan manuals and ends as claims, and outsourced billing services do it remotely.

why_ai: Licensed optometrists diagnose and treat chronic eye disease in person for patients who return to them for years, and demand grows with an ageing population.
why_clarity: Testing protocols exist and visits recur, but disease courses vary and treatment outcomes appear over months to years.
why_digital: Patients are examined and treated in the chair, with digital imaging in support, at local practices.

why_ai: The licensed optometrist makes and signs the progression and referral call on noisy, ambiguous tests, and patients stay with a doctor they trust for years.
why_clarity: Tests repeat on a schedule, but experts disagree on progression and the truth emerges over years.
why_digital: Scans and fields are digital and reviewed on screen, but they are captured from the patient in the office and acted on in person.

why_ai: Treatments such as IPL and gland expression are hands-on procedures under an optometrist's licence, sold to patients who trust the practice.
why_clarity: Courses follow device protocols and recur, but relief is symptom-based and varies between patients.
why_digital: Every session is delivered on the patient's eyelids in a local office.

why_ai: Releasing prescriptions, answering verification requests and reordering lenses are rule-bound tasks software can run, with the prescriber accountable for each response.
why_clarity: The FTC rule sets exact duties and deadlines, requests repeat daily, and each response is right or wrong within hours.
why_digital: Requests and prescriptions are documents and calls, lenses ship by mail, and online sellers compete nationally.

why_ai: Turning exam findings into result codes, letters and plan files is codified data work that extraction and agents can do.
why_clarity: Measure specifications define the codes and evidence exactly, every diabetic exam repeats the task, and plan credit confirms it.
why_digital: The work starts from the chart and ends as codes, letters and data files exchanged electronically.

why_ai: Fitting myopia-control lenses on children and guiding families through a multi-year programme is licensed, hands-on and built on trust.
why_clarity: Axial length gives a measurable target and visits recur, but responses vary and the payoff is measured over years.
why_digital: Children are measured and fitted in the office, with biometer data and growth charts on screen in support.

why_ai: Children must be examined and fitted in person by licensed optometrists, and demand for that care is unaffected by AI.
why_clarity: The exam and benefit rules are defined and recur, though completion depends on families and schools.
why_digital: The exam happens in a local office or mobile clinic that families have to reach in person.

why_ai: Checking portals and turning benefit text into estimates is screen work that agents and eligibility software replace directly.
why_clarity: Benefits are defined per plan, checks repeat for every visit, and the adjudicated claim confirms the estimate within days.
why_digital: The inputs are portals and eligibility responses and the output is a digital benefits card, done by remote vendors as easily as on site.

why_ai: The patient must sit at the device and an optometrist signs the prescription, but automated and remote systems are taking over the measurement itself.
why_clarity: Refraction follows a codified sequence thousands of times, and remakes show within weeks whether the prescription was right.
why_digital: Measurements are digital and remote optometrists refine them by video, but the patient is in a local office and the glasses are physical.

why_ai: Trial design and graded endpoints carry regulatory accountability and sponsor trust, and demand for eye-drug and myopia trials keeps growing.
why_clarity: Protocols, grading charters and endpoints are written down and repeat across trials, with results checked at database lock.
why_digital: The work runs on site data and images and ends as datasets and analyses delivered to sponsors anywhere.

why_ai: Plan analysts set reimbursement and network policy on claims data that automated analytics increasingly handle, under regulatory accountability.
why_clarity: Claims and allowances are structured and repeat by the million, though network and pricing effects show over plan years.
why_digital: The work is done on claims data and delivered as schedules, policies and reports to employers and practices.

why_ai: Deal and integration analysts make consequential, ambiguous calls for sponsors and boards, who keep paying for accountable judgement.
why_clarity: Acquisition models and productivity reports have known shapes, but each deal differs and results show over years.
why_digital: Analysis runs on practice data and financials on screen, while deals are won through relationships with selling owners.

why_ai: Licensure exams carry legal defensibility and the trust of state boards, which keep paying a national body to stand behind them.
why_clarity: Psychometric methods are codified and exam cycles repeat, with item statistics checked after each window.
why_digital: Items and analyses are digital, but exams are delivered at test centres and clinical sites and the buyer is one national market.

why_ai: Model development is screen work under FDA accountability, and the product itself automates the read it sells.
why_clarity: Gradeable endpoints and validation protocols are defined and repeat for every image, with performance checked against reference graders.
why_digital: The work starts from images and ends as software results delivered to clinics remotely.

why_ai: Professional affairs teams sell through relationships with optometrists, but their market and panel analysis is screen work AI handles well.
why_clarity: Panels, shipments and trials repeat in known formats, though their effect on prescribing is judged over quarters.
why_digital: The work runs on sales, panel and trial data, while results reach practices through field representatives and education.

why_ai: Normative databases and algorithms ship inside regulated devices that practices keep buying, though the analysis itself is screen work.
why_clarity: Study protocols and algorithm validation are codified, with performance checked against reference standards.
why_digital: Data and algorithms are digital, but they are delivered inside physical devices sold through local channels.

why_ai: A profession-run registry is trusted because optometrists govern it, and quality reporting demand keeps it funded.
why_clarity: Measure definitions and data harvests are standard and repeat each cycle, though research use is open-ended.
why_digital: Data flows from EHRs and returns as dashboards and submissions, entirely online.

why_ai: Consultants are paid for credentialed judgement in audits and defence, but rule lookup and chart review are automating.
why_clarity: Coding rules are codified and audits repeat, though payer audit outcomes take months.
why_digital: Charts are reviewed and guidance delivered remotely, with seminars as the main in-person channel.

why_ai: Panel and survey reporting is screen work AI can automate, though trust in an industry body's numbers sustains demand.
why_clarity: Panel methods and report formats repeat each release, but there is no quick check that a market estimate was right.
why_digital: Surveys, data and reports are digital and sold by subscription and membership.

why_ai: Members join for negotiated rebates and peer relationships, while benchmarking and bookkeeping are routine screen work.
why_clarity: Rebate rules and bookkeeping are defined and recur, while the value of membership shows over years.
why_digital: Benchmarks, bookkeeping and rebates are handled online, with meetings and field consultants as the in-person channel.

why_ai: Licensing and enforcement decisions are statutory acts by accountable officials, and AI changes nothing about who must make them.
why_clarity: Statutes define the rules, but complaints and scope disputes vary and resolve slowly.
why_digital: Applications, complaints and orders are documents handled on screen, but the buyer is a single state or federal agency.

why_ai: Licensed readers sign each grade, but autonomous AI already reads the same images and competes for the same programmes.
why_clarity: Grading scales are standard, reads repeat by the thousand, and reference grading checks them quickly.
why_digital: Images arrive digitally from remote cameras and reads are returned online to clinics anywhere.
